lead_disclosure.privacy_paragraph_html: We work with one contractor who serves Elkhorn and handles every request from this site. When you call or send a request, only that contractor receives your details (name, phone number, email and address), so they can contact you about your project. No other contractor sees your information, and if that contractor cannot take the job, your request is not passed to anyone else. That contractor may pay us a fee for the referral, and we do not sell your information to anyone else.
